{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "state_declined",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "has_travel_keyword",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Binary interpretable flag with well-separated groups (359/141) that can be segmented against decline rate; captures a content signal from the description."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_auto_generated_language",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable binary indicator of boilerplate/auto-generated text, a plausible associational signal for declines with a decent split (349/151)."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_expense_keyword",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable keyword flag; split is skewed (435/65) but the minority group is large enough to compare decline rates."
    },
    {
      "name": "has_equipment_keyword",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable flag distinguishing equipment-related descriptions (440/60), a meaningful category to segment against the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "is_travel_category",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear categorical segmentation (354/146) directly relevant to travel-expense declines; groupable and comparable."
    },
    {
      "name": "desc_word_count",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable ordinal scale of description length concentrated in 3-9 words; can be binned and compared, though borderline mechanical it remains human-readable."
    },
    {
      "name": "amount_tier",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Excellent interpretable segmentation (low/medium/high) with well-populated categories, ideal for comparing decline rates by spend level."
    },
    {
      "name": "travel_expense_signal",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distribution (359/141) is identical to has_travel_keyword, indicating it duplicates that flag rather than adding a distinct relationship."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 7,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "As a set, these columns provide several interpretable, well-separated segmentations (amount_tier, is_travel_category, and the keyword/auto-generated flags) that a human can group on and compare against decline rates, satisfying the EDA claim. Weaknesses: travel_expense_signal appears to duplicate has_travel_keyword, and several columns are thematically overlapping travel/keyword flags rather than diverse external axes; desc_word_count is somewhat mechanical. No column is opaque or near-constant, but the redundancy and clustering around a single theme cap the informativeness."
}
